mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the potatoes was the strongest payoff: the seed pieces became a substantial crop, tying the meal to the earlier growing effort.

leastWorthwhile.text: Shelling and soaking the beans were sensible, but the consecutive preparation steps felt somewhat repetitive.

surprise.text: I appreciated that the beans were fully cooked before the potatoes were added, with a separate second heating for the stew.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the cloth caught the shelled beans, and the cooking order had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue for the departure and specimen story, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this largely linear meal preparation offered.
